title: Austerity, Gender, and Multidimensional Deprivation Among Older Europeans: Evidence from SHARE
abstract: arXiv:2610.30527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies whether fiscal consolidation is associated with deeper multidimensional deprivation among older women than among older men, and through which channel. Using six waves of SHARE across eleven European countries, it builds a multidimensional deprivation index spanning functional health, economic insecurity, and social exclusion, and relates it to the cyclically adjusted primary balance (CAPB) at the country-wave level in a two-way fixed-effects model. Consolidation raises deprivation on average with a null average gender gap, which is later found to conceal regional heterogeneity where the gender gap is positive and significant in Southern and Eastern Europe, and absent in Continental/Nordic Europe. This regional pattern holds under individual clustering but does not survive clustering at the country level. translated_title: 紧缩政策、性别与欧洲老年人的多维剥夺：来自SHARE的证据
translated_abstract: 本文研究财政紧缩是否与老年女性比老年男性更深的多维剥夺相关，以及通过何种渠道产生影响。利用涵盖十一个欧洲国家的六轮SHARE（健康、老龄化与退休调查）数据，本文构建了一个涵盖功能性健康、经济不安全与社会排斥的多维剥夺指数，并在双向固定效应模型中将其与国家-调查轮次层面的周期性调整基本余额（CAPB）相联系。研究发现，财政紧缩平均上会加剧剥夺，但平均性别差距为零；进一步分析显示，这一结果掩盖了区域异质性——性别差距在南欧和东欧显著为正，而在欧洲大陆/北欧国家则不存在。该区域模式在个体层面聚类标准误下成立，但在国家层面聚类下不再稳健。此外，文献所预测的经济不安全渠道的作用方向却相反，男性的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用SHARE数据构建多维剥夺指数，发现财政紧缩平均上加剧欧洲老年人的剥夺且总体性别差距为零，但这一零均值掩盖了区域异质性——性别差距仅在南欧和东欧显著存在，且相关结论对国家层面聚类并不稳健。
en_tdlr: Using SHARE data to build a multidimensional deprivation index, this paper finds that fiscal consolidation raises deprivation among older Europeans with no average gender gap, but this null average conceals regional heterogeneity, as the gender gap is significant only in Southern and Eastern Europe and the finding is not robust to country-level clustering.
